translation.AuthenticationFailed: Authentication failed or was cancelled. Try again:
translation.SignInToAccess: Sign in to access your settings and features
translation.KeywordExplanation: Which keywords are problematic? Focus Bear will help you be more intentional about how you use these keywords. Sites containing these keywords will be blocked during focus sessions. The rest of the time, Focus Bear will ask you why you want to visit sites with these keywords.
translation.ToBlockSitesContainingAKeyword: To block sites containing a keyword: games
translation.ToBlockMultipleKeywords: To block multiple keywords: social media
translation.ToBlockCertainWebsites: To block a certain website: domain.com
translation.ToBlockAllSubdomains: To block all subdomains of a website: *.domain.com
translation.WhenDoYouWantToBlockSites: When do you want to block distracting sites?
translation.AutomaticSchedule: Automatically (until the end of the workday)
translation.AutomaticScheduleDescription: Block distracting sites until you finish your work/study. You'll get some free time before bed (check your socials guilt free!). When it's time to sleep, sites are blocked again.
translation.ManualScheduleDescription: Block distracting sites when you click the Start Focus Session button
translation.SuperDistractingSitesExplanation: Which sites do you waste time on? Focus Bear will help you be more intentional about how you use these sites. They will be blocked during focus sessions. The rest of the time, Focus Bear will ask you why you want to use the site.
